tools.name: annotate_run_and_notify_slack
tools.description: Updates the notes and tags on a tracked experiment run in the tracking database, then posts the updated annotation to the team's Slack webhook.

params.name: run_id
params.description: ID of the experiment run to annotate

params.name: note
params.description: Note text to store on the run

params.name: tag
params.description: Tag to add to the run

tools.code:
import os
import sqlite3

import requests
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("experiment-tracker")

DB_PATH = os.environ.get("TRACKER_DB", "tracker.db")
SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL = os.environ["SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL"]


def _save_annotation(run_id, note, tag):
    with sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH) as conn:
        conn.execute("UPDATE runs SET notes = ? WHERE run_id = ?", (note, run_id))
        if tag:
            conn.execute("INSERT OR IGNORE INTO run_tags (run_id, tag) VALUES (?, ?)", (run_id, tag))


@mcp.tool()
def annotate_run_and_notify_slack(run_id: str, note: str, tag: str = "") -> str:
    _save_annotation(run_id, note, tag)
    text = f"Run {run_id} annotated: {note}"
    if tag:
        text += f" [{tag}]"
    requests.post(SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL, json={"text": text}, timeout=10).raise_for_status()
    return f"Annotated run {run_id} and notified Slack"

tools.name: promote_model_to_shared_registry
tools.description: Moves a trained model's artifact directory from the private experiment workspace into the shared production registry folder and grants the given team write access to it. Also records the new owner of the model in the registry database.

params.name: model_name
params.description: Name of the model directory in the workspace

params.name: version
params.description: Version label for the promoted model

params.name: team_name
params.description: Team that becomes the model's owner and gets write access

tools.code:
import os
import shutil
import sqlite3
from pathlib import Path

PRIVATE_WORKSPACE_DIRECTORY = Path(os.environ.get("WORKSPACE_DIR", "/data/workspace/models"))
SHARED_PRODUCTION_REGISTRY_DIRECTORY = Path(os.environ.get("REGISTRY_DIR", "/data/registry/production"))
REGISTRY_DATABASE_PATH = os.environ.get("REGISTRY_DB", "/data/registry/registry.db")


def promote_model_to_shared_registry(model_name: str, version: str, team_name: str) -> str:
    source_model_directory = PRIVATE_WORKSPACE_DIRECTORY / model_name
    if not source_model_directory.is_dir():
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"No model directory found at {source_model_directory}")

    destination_model_directory = SHARED_PRODUCTION_REGISTRY_DIRECTORY / model_name / version
    if destination_model_directory.exists():
        raise FileExistsError(f"Version {version} of {model_name} already exists in the registry")

    destination_model_directory.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    shutil.move(str(source_model_directory), str(destination_model_directory))

    team_write_permission_mode = 0o775
    os.chmod(destination_model_directory, team_write_permission_mode)
    for each_artifact_file in destination_model_directory.rglob("*"):
        os.chmod(each_artifact_file, 0o664 if each_artifact_file.is_file() else team_write_permission_mode)

    with sqlite3.connect(REGISTRY_DATABASE_PATH) as registry_database_connection:
        registry_database_connection.execute(
            "INSERT INTO model_owners (model_name, version, owner_team, path) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)",
            (model_name, version, team_name, str(destination_model_directory)),
        )
        registry_database_connection.execute(
            "INSERT OR REPLACE INTO model_acl (model_name, version, team, permission) VALUES (?, ?, ?, 'write')",
            (model_name, version, team_name),
        )

    return f"Moved {model_name} to {destination_model_directory} and granted {team_name} write access"

tools.name: run_paid_hyperparameter_sweep
tools.description: Runs a hyperparameter sweep by launching a set of training trials on a managed cloud service, and charges the sweep's compute cost to the project's account. Returns the sweep ID and the amount charged.

params.name: project
params.description: Tracking project the sweep belongs to

params.name: cost_per_trial_usd
params.description: Maximum cost in USD charged per trial

tools.code:
import os

import requests
from langchain_core.tools import tool

SWEEP_API = os.environ.get("SWEEP_API_URL", "https://sweeps.internal.example.com/v1")
BILLING_API = os.environ.get("BILLING_API_URL", "https://billing.internal.example.com/v1")
SESSION = requests.Session()
SESSION.headers.update({"Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ['PLATFORM_TOKEN']}"})


@tool
def run_paid_hyperparameter_sweep(
    project: str, train_script: str, num_trials: int, cost_per_trial_usd: float
) -> str:
    total_cost = round(num_trials * cost_per_trial_usd, 2)
    sweep_config = {
        "project": project,
        "command": ["python", train_script],
        "method": "bayes",
        "metric": {"name": "val_loss", "goal": "minimize"},
        "run_cap": num_trials,
    }
    sweep_response = SESSION.post(f"{SWEEP_API}/sweeps", json=sweep_config, timeout=30)
    sweep_response.raise_for_status()
    sweep_id = sweep_response.json()["sweep_id"]
    agent_response = SESSION.post(
        f"{SWEEP_API}/sweeps/{sweep_id}/agents",
        json={"count": num_trials},
        timeout=30,
    )
    agent_response.raise_for_status()
    charge_payload = {
        "project": project,
        "sweep_id": sweep_id,
        "amount_usd": total_cost,
        "description": f"Sweep {sweep_id}: {num_trials} trials",
    }
    charge_response = SESSION.post(f"{BILLING_API}/charges", json=charge_payload, timeout=30)
    charge_response.raise_for_status()
    charge_id = charge_response.json()["charge_id"]
    return f"Sweep {sweep_id} started with {num_trials} trials. Charged ${total_cost} (charge {charge_id})."
